job_id.name: job_id
job_id.comment: Unique identifier for the job posting

job_title.name: job_title
job_title.comment: Title of the job as posted.

company_name.name: company_name
company_name.comment: Name of the company that posted the job.

job_location.name: job_location
job_location.comment: Location (city/region) associated with the job posting.

job_via.name: job_via
job_via.comment: Job board or site the posting was found on (e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed).

job_schedule_type.name: job_schedule_type
job_schedule_type.comment: Type of work schedule (e.g. Full-time, Part-time, Contract).

job_work_from_home.name: job_work_from_home
job_work_from_home.comment: Boolean flag indicating if the job can be done remotely.

search_date.name: search_date
search_date.comment: Date the job posting was scraped/searched for.

search_term.name: search_term
search_term.comment: Search keyword/role used to find this job posting (e.g. "data analyst").

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: jobs_per_month
metadata.comment: Count of job postings per month and per searched role.

month.name: month
month.comment: First day of the month the postings were scraped on (search_date truncated to month).

role.name: role
role.comment: Search term/role the postings were grouped by (from search_term).

postings.name: postings
postings.comment: Number of job postings for this month/role combination.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: monthly_summary
metadata.comment: Monthly summary of job postings; one row per month.

month.name: month
month.comment: Year and month of the summary.

total_postings.name: total_postings
total_postings.comment: All postings that month (summed from jobs_per_month).

pct_remote.name: pct_remote
pct_remote.comment: Share of the month's postings flagged remote, percent.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: top_locations
metadata.comment: Top 10 locations by number of job postings.

postings.name: postings
postings.comment: Number of job postings in this location.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table
